say:3:1220804001:1.text: I can't believe my eyes; there are actually people in the lumberyard who aren't with the Whispers!

say:4:1220804002:1.source_cn: 等等！看你的衣服……你是水鬼帮的人！

say:7:1220804005:1.text: My daughter is gravely ill and her doctors say she needs foxtail grass, but it's only found on faraway islands.
say:7:1220804005:1.source_cn: 我女儿病得很重，医生开的药又需要用到狸尾草，但这种果子...

say:8:1220804006:1.text: Rustport had been shut down for a long time, and I couldn't buy it anywhere in the city. With no other options, I had to join the Water Wights and accompany them out to sea to search for it.
say:8:1220804006:1.source_cn: 那时候锈锚港已经封闭很久了，我跑遍了全城也没买到。无奈...

say:9:1220804007:1.text: I understand... But why are you here? Didn't you find some foxtail grass?
say:9:1220804007:1.source_cn: 原来如此……可你为什么会在这里呢？没有找到狸尾草吗？

say:10:1220804008:1.text: I gathered quite a lot of it, but on my return trip, my boat was spotted by the Carmine Whispers. They refused to hear me out and just captured me as a laborer!
say:10:1220804008:1.source_cn: 不，我在岛上摘了不少狸尾草。但是返航的时候，我坐的船被...

say:11:1220804009:1.text: I tried to escape, but the lumberyard is locked up tighter than a drum, not even a fly could escape. I was beaten several times for trying, and now it's hard enough just to walk...
say:11:1220804009:1.source_cn: 我也试着逃跑过，但伐木场被看守得很严，连只鸟都飞不出去...

say:12:1220804010:1.text: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.
say:12:1220804010:1.source_cn: 我实在没办法了……你们能帮帮我吗？只要帮我把狸尾草带回...
say:12:1220804010:1.male: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.
say:12:1220804010:1.female: I'm at my wit's end... Can you please help me? I just need you to bring the foxtail grass back home for me.

say:18:1220804013:1.text: The Whispers took almost all of my valuables, but I have some money tucked away at home! If you deliver the foxtail grass, my wife will surely reward you.
